notes.title: Improving the Trials and the dog...anyway...Happy Easter!
notes.notes:
We have just finished working on a bunch of things that should've done before. 

[b]The point scoring system on the trials has been updated.[/b] Now, If you fail the trial, you will get the conviction points after replaying it. The system should work without any bugs now.

[b]Now you can pause the trial by opening the game menu.[/b] Yes, we should've implemented it before. Our apologies. Now you can pause the game at any point during the trial. 

[b]The tension is less buggy and more manageable.[/b] This feature wasn't as fun as we expected. The tension will never go up by 10 points anymore. There will be no more accident trial failures due to the stacking of unmanageable amounts of tension. 

[b]The dog sounds don't overlap anymore. [/b] Initially, Tobius was just something one of our amazing kickstarter backers asked us to add to the game. To our surprise, many people liked petting our cute doggy from time to time and weren't happy with the sounds overlapping. 
[u]If you didn't play the game for the while, the other sounds and the music has been improved too. [/u]

We are aware of the issues with the texts. Currently, we're looking for volunteers to help with our grammar. We would appreciate your help! Please, sign up using the contacts below!  

Contact us:
e-mail: femidathegame@gmail.com
discord: https://discord.gg/V5c7ckf
You can also help by reporting bugs.
 
Happy Easter! 
We wish you and your loved ones strong health!

notes.title: All bugs have been patched! Steam Cloud support is coming soon!
notes.notes:
A couple of people had problems with saving. We described the bug in detail in the previous announcement. We added a backup saving system which will allow us to also support Steam Cloud. 

The issue with conviction points after failing a trial no longer exists in the current version. There is no penalty for failing a trial anymore. 

Please report bugs to: femidathegame@gmail.com 
alternatively to our discord: https://discord.gg/V5c7ckf

Thanks for your trust and patience!

notes.title: We've fixed the texts and bugs! Enjoy Femida!
notes.notes:
No more broken English. One amazing proofreader fixed our grammar and spelling. We have also patched all the known bugs. Although only one person encountered the problems with saving, we're determined to update the saving system to avoid any similar bugs in the future. 

Here is how can you check whenever you have this bug or not:
1) Start the game and play for some time. 
2) Save the game.
3) Exit the main menu and load the save.
If you see a black screen it means the save data hasn't been recorded. If the game loads - you're good to go. 
Solution: turn off your antivirus, Windows Defender or any other similar anti-malware software. We store the saves in your registry (We know. Our bad.), some software may prevent the game from writing to your registry.  

The saving system update is up next. No one will lose their current saves. The new system will be built on top of the existing and serve as a backup. This will also enable you to use Steam Cloud Saving service. 

There are plans for adding steam achievements for every ending you can get in the game, but Femida needs to at least break even to enable us to work on it more. Please contact us if you can help. 

In regards to the localization: our great community wants to play Femida in Russian and Mandarin. We will work once the game gets enough wishlist addition from Russia and China. Please, contact us if you think the game will do well in your language too or if you want to volunteer.  

We apologize for the bad experience! We messed up the launch. Thanks for your trust!

Our email: femidathegame@gmail.com

notes.title: Femida is out but there some issues. Antivirus software prevents saving!
notes.notes:
There are issues with saving on some machines. Antiviruses, windows defender and other anti-malware/spyware software prevent the save data from being recorded. We will change our saving system in the future to avoid this bug. Right now, it is a little bit dangerous as we can wipe out the saves of the majority of people for whom the current saving system is working fine in the process of updating it.   
We've hired an editor to fix the problems with our grammar. Sorry about that! Turns our English isn't as good as we thought. 

Just to clarify: we're a small studio with no one working full time on the game. It's not an excuse. We're determined to fix all the issues soon.
